india_trends.title: Centre to sell 6.5% stake in LIC at floor price of ₹382/share; retail investors can bid on 5 August — All we know

india_trends.title: Gold buyers rush to lock prices as festive bookings begin early

india_trends.title: IREDA Q1 Results: Net profit rises 37% YoY to ₹339 crore; asset quality stays stable
india_trends.summary: IREDA's Q1 FY27 showed mixed results with net profit at ₹339 crore, up 37.1% YoY but down 31.3% sequentially. Revenue rose 15.5% YoY to ₹2,249 crore, offset by increased finance costs and provisions, impacting profitability despite stable asset quality.

india_trends.title: Escorts Kubota Q1 FY27 results: Net profit rises 4.4% to Rs 386 crore, revenue jumps 28%
india_trends.summary: In the June quarter, Escorts Kubota reported a notable 4.4 percent growth in net profit. The company enjoyed a significant 28 percent increase in operational revenue, amounting to Rs 3,207.55 crore. Revenue from agri machinery rose by 27 percent while construction equipment sales jumped 39 percent.

india_trends.title: MakeMyTrip Q1 bookings rise 20%; AI assistant drives growth
india_trends.summary: MakeMyTrip reported a 19.9% year-on-year rise in Q1 gross bookings to $2.85 billion, while revenue and adjusted operating profit increased despite travel disruptions. Strong growth across hotels, buses and AI-powered Myra 2.0 reinforced confidence in India’s long-term travel demand.
